model._note: The capability model (Phase 7; spec SURVIVAL_HOMESTEAD_WORLD_CAPABILITY §3-4, MASTER_PLAN §3.2-3.3 and §4.7). One definition per capability, read by every module: the Survival Lab, the Homestead, the profiles, the scenarios and the facilities all refer to these ids. The 27 capabilities the wilderness engine has always had keep their ids and their evidence (wilderness/engine.py produces it); the eight new ones get theirs from the rules below (capability/records.py). Edit freely; capability/records.py and app/capability_pack.py rebuild everything that reads this.

field_policy._note: The field-function policy (D-018, D-026-D-030) and the Blackthorn standard for a field move's slot cost. A field move earns its slot in battle if it's a damaging move of at least `battle_worthy_bp` power that generation, or one of `battle_worthy`; anything else costs a battle slot. That threshold is a Blackthorn standard, not a game rule: change it here.
